# Lab 18.13: Organisation Policies

## What We Are Going to Do
Restrict where BigQuery data can be stored and require CMEK, using organisation policy constraints at project level. This needs a Google Cloud organisation.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Restrict resource locations.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">cat &gt; location_policy.yaml &lt;&lt;EOF
name: projects/$PROJECT_ID/policies/gcp.resourceLocations
spec:
  rules:
  - values:
      allowedValues:
      - in:us-locations
EOF
gcloud org-policies set-policy location_policy.yaml</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Test it.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq --location=asia-south1 mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab18_mumbai</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   It fails because `asia-south1` is not in the allowed US locations.

3. **[CLI] Require CMEK for BigQuery.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">cat &gt; cmek_policy.yaml &lt;&lt;EOF
name: projects/$PROJECT_ID/policies/gcp.restrictNonCmekServices
spec:
  rules:
  - values:
      deniedValues:
      - bigquery.googleapis.com
EOF
gcloud org-policies set-policy cmek_policy.yaml
bq --location=US mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab18_no_key      # fails: no CMEK</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[Console] See the policies.** **IAM & Admin → Organization policies**, search **Restrict Resource Service Usage**, **Resource Location Restriction** and **Restrict which services may create resources without CMEK**.

5. **[CLI] Remove both policies** so later labs work.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud org-policies delete gcp.resourceLocations --project=$PROJECT_ID
gcloud org-policies delete gcp.restrictNonCmekServices --project=$PROJECT_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Location policy | Datasets only in US locations |
| CMEK policy | Datasets must use a customer key |
| Scope | Organisation, folder or project |
| Requirement | An organisation |
